questions.question: Describe the representation of a two-dimensional array in memory. Explain how elements are stored linearly even though they are logically arranged in rows and columns. / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• Describe the representation of a two-dimensional array in memory. Explain how
  • elements are stored linearly even though they are logically arranged in rows and
  • columns.
  • A two-dimensional array is stored in contiguous memory locations. In row-major order,
  • all elements of the first row are stored followed by the next rows. In column-major order,
  • elements of columns are stored consecutively. Address calculation is used to access
  • elements. Give explanation.
